name: President Collins

tenures.source: The fed's own founding operator, self-billed on-air announcing tournament brackets at Tuesday Time Bomb (26 May 1998).
the promotion's own house-show broadcast, 24 October 1999

caption: The fed's own founder and president, appearing on-air to announce upcoming title tournaments.

name: Tiger

tenures.source: Won the fed's own inaugural Heavyweight Championship tournament, wrestling three times in one night.

The character's own 21 and 22 October 1998 posts (msgs nAt7r3bGwkQJ, azILx9Wd-zMJ) claim to hold the "NYSWF World Heavyweight Title" alongside the still-held USWF one; the first_seen date is bounded by the promotion's own operator self-naming as NYSWF president on 24 August 1998 (see uswf-collins-1998's own provenance_notes), not by a document naming this character specifically before October.

caption: Won the fed's own first, undisputed Heavyweight Championship in a one-night, eight-man tournament, wrestling three times in a single show.

name: Shane Johnson

tenures.source: Reached the Heavyweight Championship tournament final, losing to Tiger after interference from The Rebel.

caption: The fed's own newest recruit, runner-up in its first Heavyweight Championship tournament.

name: "Terrorist" TJ Miles

tenures.source: Lost the Heavyweight Championship tournament's opening round to Shane Johnson; lost a rematch to Ricardo Clement two days later.

caption: A tournament entrant billed as 'The Terrorist.'

name: Canibus

tenures.source: Failed to show for his own Heavyweight Championship tournament match, giving Tiger an automatic bye.

caption: A tournament entrant who never showed for his own match, giving Tiger a bye.

name: Dave Martens

tenures.source: Reached the Heavyweight Championship tournament's final four before losing to Tiger.

caption: A tournament semifinalist, eliminated by Tiger with a chair-assisted finisher.

name: Hellscream

tenures.source: Lost the Heavyweight Championship tournament's opening round to Dave Martens after interference from Tiger and The Rebel.

caption: A tournament entrant eliminated after Tiger and The Rebel interfered in his match.

name: The Rebel

tenures.source: Tiger's own ringside ally through the Heavyweight Championship tournament, interfering in three of its matches.

caption: Tiger's own ringside ally, whose interference shaped three of the fed's first tournament matches.

identity.note: A different persona of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the museum's own collection; nothing in the wing's own record links the two beyond a common, unremarkable wrestling gimmick name.

name: Buddy Brown

tenures.source: One half of the tag team The Dominators; won the fed's own first Tag Team Championship, then fought to a no-contest against Dan Miles after interference from the rival stable The Public Enemy.

caption: One half of the tag team The Dominators, the fed's own first Tag Team Champions.

name: Satre

tenures.source: One half of the tag team The Dominators; won the fed's own first Tag Team Championship, then lost a singles match to Fort Knox after interference from the rival stable The Public Enemy.

caption: One half of the tag team The Dominators, the fed's own first Tag Team Champions; billed by his full name, Joe Satre, in singles competition.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (joe-satre-ewa-email); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Loco

tenures.source: One half of the tag team Voices In Your Head; won the tournament's opening round, then lost the tag title final to The Dominators.

caption: One half of the tag team Voices In Your Head, runner-up for the fed's own first Tag Team Championship.

identity.note: A different persona of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the museum's own collection; nothing in the wing's own record links the two beyond a common, unremarkable wrestling gimmick name.

name: Psyche

tenures.source: One half of the tag team Voices In Your Head; won the tournament's opening round, then lost the tag title final to The Dominators.

caption: One half of the tag team Voices In Your Head, runner-up for the fed's own first Tag Team Championship.

name: "Bad Ass" Dan Miles

tenures.source: Won a heavily-interfered match over Ricardo Clement; fought to a no-contest against Buddy Brown two days later after The Public Enemy attacked both men.

caption: A wrestler nicknamed 'Bad Ass,' twice caught up in interference from a masked ally and a rival stable.

name: Ricardo Clement

tenures.source: Lost to Dan Miles after ringside interference; defeated TJ Miles in a rematch two days later.

caption: One of several wrestlers billed under the Clement family name.

name: Fort Knox

tenures.source: Defeated Satre after the rival stable The Public Enemy interfered on his behalf.

caption: A wrestler who defeated one of the fed's own reigning Tag Team Champions in singles competition, with help from a rival stable.
